name: B10-0027/2024 (PfE) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament says the July 2024 presidential election in Venezuela was stolen. It does not recognise Nicolás Maduro as the winner. It recognises the opposition candidate, Edmundo González Urrutia, as the legitimate president. It asks the European Union and its member states to do the same. It also asks for sanctions on people in the Venezuelan regime, for all political prisoners to be freed, and for support for international court investigations. This is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament recognises Edmundo González Urrutia as Venezuela's legitimate president, not Nicolás Maduro.
- It asks the European Union and its member states to follow suit and to impose more sanctions.
- It calls for all political prisoners to be released and backs international court investigations.
